dependencies.notes: sha256 is the upstream release tarball; the vendored files are verbatim except that upstream tests/ are not vendored

dependencies.name: signalsmith-stretch
dependencies.purpose: Pitch-preserving offline media variants and streaming master-playrate source conversion (ADR-0045). Header only
dependencies.notes: sha256 is the upstream release tarball; upstream cmd/, web/ and tests/ are not vendored. Local patch adds reset(seed), clears seek/silence/smoothing state, and uses a fixed SplitMix64 integer sequence with explicit 24-bit float/53-bit double uniform conversion for deterministic streaming seeks across standard libraries. Default reset retains the current RNG sequence; explicitly supplied custom engines keep upstream distribution behavior.

dependencies.name: lua
dependencies.purpose: Embedded scripting language (ADR-0006): libs/lua-bus runs user scripts on the model thread. Upstream src/ is unmodified; only the core and the sandbox libraries are compiled (io, os, debug and package are never built).

dependencies.name: mir
dependencies.purpose: JIT compiler and interpreter behind DSP scripts (ADR-0032): plugins/suite compiles scripts to MIR and runs them as machine code or interpreted. Only the core, generator and interpreter sources are vendored (no c2mir, tests or tools).
dependencies.notes: The first local patch replaces an assertion in the register allocator (an instruction naming one spilled register three times, as in d = d * d after coalescing) with the generator's ordinary reload, which aborted the host compiling such a script. The second gives the x86-64 pattern for a float == or != the optional REX prefix every other ucomiss pattern has: without it the size estimate for xmm8-15 operands fell a byte short, which aborted a debug host and could make a release build choose a short jump that does not reach.
